One-shot: ensure default image, start an instance for cwd, launch Claude.

Re-runnable: if an instance already exists for the current workspace it is reconnected (running) or restarted (stopped) instead of being recreated. For per-instance tuning (profiles, mounts, image, ...) use `iso setup` / `iso up` directly.

Usage: iso quickstart [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --no-workspace
          Skip mounting the current directory as the workspace

      --no-devcontainer
          Ignore any discovered `devcontainer.json` (escape hatch for CI)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
